title: Specify a News API Contract
prompt: Write and test the HTTP contract for article listing, conditional refresh, article lookup, bookmarking, conflict, rate limit, and typed error responses.
successCriteria: Every method and status has explicit body semantics.
Cache validators and sensitive-header policy are defined.
Retry safety is documented per operation.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.

starterCode.code: interface NewsHttpContract { /* methods, status, headers, representations */ }

solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
